markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (97%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set; second model and all 5 neighbors agree. [F1]

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 97%, Benign 3% | Clear lead |
| Conformal set | Normal only | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.997 / 80th percentile | Typical input |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal | Unanimous |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules** (regions 8, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · High score; linked to lower invasive likelihood [F2] · Unreliable
- **Gland/tubule formation** (regions 1, 2, 4) · ↓ invasive · High score; linked to lower invasive likelihood [F3] · Weak
- **Benign stroma or fat** (regions 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical benign background fits low invasive risk · Validated
- **Mitotic figures** (regions 6, 7) · ↑ invasive · Above typical here, but spot check failed · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing its top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007); not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules and mitoses are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- A small focus in regions 6–7 (highest region risk, 4% and 6%) is under-represented.
- Probabilities are approximate: ECE 0.05 (CI 0.03–0.18) on 132 test images.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 6, 7:** Look for mitoses and atypia; the mitosis concept failed its spot check.
2. **Regions 8, 10, 11:** Confirm normal lobular architecture; this concept failed its spot check.
3. **Regions 1, 2, 4:** Confirm gland formation is benign.
